name: Gods Children
overview: Scripture reveals that children are a precious heritage from the Lord, a reward and blessing from Him (Psalms 127:3). The Bible emphasizes the importance of nurturing and training children in the way they should go, promising that such guidance will endure throughout their lives (Proverbs 22:6). Jesus Himself valued children highly, welcoming them and teaching that the kingdom of heaven belongs to those who are like them (Matthew 19:14), while warning against despising or hindering them (Matthew 18:10; Mark 10:13). This teaching highlights both the spiritual significance and the responsibility entrusted to families and the church in honoring and raising God’s children.
